source: PDOK BZK Locatieserver v3_1, BAG address points (centroide_rd), resolved by exact straatnaam + huisnummer in Amsterdam
note: Named regression locations for the pilot boundary, per the repository working agreement. Expectations come from the build prompt's stated boundary (Brouwersgracht / Leidsegracht / Singel / Prinsengracht + the first Jordaan row), not from whatever the current boundary happens to produce. A BAG address point sits inside the building and can be tens of metres behind the facade, so these test the boundary with margin rather than to the metre.
